question: At the observed odds-capture and results-refresh cadence, is UFC accumulating a leakage-safe backtest at all — and if so, how fast?
verdictBasis: Two odds captures, 30.69 days apart, both triggered by hand, is a sample of one interval. It cannot establish a cadence, a capture rate, or an accrual projection. The one thing it does establish is a hard structural fact, below: zero captured bouts overlap the results corpus, so the accrual rate measured to date is 0 rows.
sourcesRead: app/public/data/ufc/odds-snapshots/ (immutable pregame snapshots, written by pipeline/ufc/build_odds.py:107-115)

oddsCapture.gapsNote: Cards took place between the two captures (the 2026-06-14 through 2026-06-27 bouts in snapshot 1 are the only ones with a capture at all). No capture exists for any card after 2026-07-12, and the 2026-06-15 UFC Freedom 250 card that WAS settled has no snapshot under its own event date beyond the 2026-06-09 capture.
oddsCapture.leadTimeNote: Capture 1 ran 4-18 days ahead of its bouts; capture 2 ran ~1 day ahead. Pregame-ness is satisfied in both cases (capturedAt < commenceTime for all 40 bouts), but the two captures are not comparable price points — one is an opener, one is close to closing.

resultsRefresh.note: The results corpus has never been refreshed since first ingest. Its freshness gate has not yet tripped, but it trips on 2026-09-13 without a re-run, at which point gradingReady fails closed on staleness in addition to the decisive-grade condition.

automation.evidence: grep -n cron .github/workflows/ufc-*.yml returns nothing; every file's `on:` block is workflow_dispatch only.
automation.consequence: Capture cadence is exactly equal to founder attention. There is no mechanism that captures a card if nobody remembers to dispatch ufc-pre-card before it, and the pregame window cannot be recovered afterwards.

backtestAccrual.structuralBlocker: All 40 captured bouts are dated after 2026-05-16, the last event in the results corpus. Overlap between captured odds and known results is zero, so no bout can produce a row regardless of join quality.
backtestAccrual.bindingConstraintToday: results refresh, not odds spend. A free re-run of ufc-results-refresh would extend the corpus past 2026-05-16 and could convert already-captured 2026-06/2026-07 bouts into rows. Nothing further can be inferred about how many until that run happens.
backtestAccrual.arithmeticIfCadenceWereEstablished: A card yields ~20 h2h bouts, or ~40 fighter-side rows. 150 rows is therefore roughly 4 cards captured pregame AND subsequently resulted. That is arithmetic, not a forecast: it assumes every captured bout resolves cleanly and is not a projection of when 150 will be reached.
backtestAccrual.notAnEdgeClaim: 150 clean rows unlocks a market-baseline Brier computation. It does not imply the model beats that baseline, and no promotion above SCAFFOLD_ONLY follows from row count alone.

settlementLineage.note: app/public/data/ufc/results-settled-latest.json is a separate one-off ESPN settlement of the 2026-06-15 UFC Freedom 250 test slate (6-1 moneyline). It is not produced by grade_moneylines.py, carries no boutId lineage, and is display/archive only. Its record is NOT lineage-verified under the date-qualified join contract and must not be read as grader output.

staleDerivedArtifacts.reason: written 2026-07-10, before the Lane F regrade removed the two coincidence-decided rows

staleArtifactNote: Both regenerate from the ufc-results-refresh / ufc-pre-card workflows. Regenerating them here would also flip oddsReady false on the 48h odds-staleness rule (ODDS_FRESH_HOURS, build_readiness.py:25) — environmental, and outside this lane's file ownership. They are recorded, not corrected.
whatWouldMakeThisArtifactSaySomething: a results refresh that moves latestEventDate past the captured 2026-06/2026-07 bouts
three or more captures with recorded intervals, so an interval is a distribution rather than a single number
a capture policy that fixes the lead time (opener vs close), so captured prices are comparable
moneyImpact: none — UFC has never written to the official ledger; app/public/data/mr-dub/** untouched by every UFC job.
